svg.title: FIG-05 Static connections call the shared C lifecycle One external privileged task owner advances serially
svg.desc: Cold objects: no permission for normal operation; Check call context and existing state ISR / mask / privilege / started; Pure C admission of every controller Before System/resource acquisition or controller writes; System start Return primary / cleanup / remaining effects; Acquire shared platform resources; Prepare instances in declaration order Include a failed instance in cleanup if it retained effects; start primary=SUCCESS External application may operate; no scheduler start; Product closes producers / direct writers Continue draining; join users and observers; Release acquired instances in reverse order Shrink the retained prefix only after success; Release shared platform resources; Release owned System effects Preserve each owner's receipts; stop=SUCCESS: releasable effects are withdrawn No promise to keep actively driving safe levels; Preserve primary Core rolls back in reverse order and collects cleanup; Retain uncleaned leases and storage Continue required service, then retry stop; Reject new operation Preserve the original lifecycle and effects; Explicit start; Context / STATE error; Valid context and cold state; Admission failed; no new hardware effects; All admission passed; System succeeded; Startup failed with effects retained; Startup failed with no new effects retained; Resources acquired; Shared-resource acquisition failed; All succeeded; Instance acquisition failed; Reverse rollback; Product decides to stop; Stop preconditions satisfied; All instances released; All shared resources released; Withdrawal observed complete; First instance release failed; Shared-resource release failed; System release failed; Retry retained stages; no forced reclamation; New lifecycle
